# Vendored browser libraries

Copied unmodified from npm so the site works on a LAN without internet access.
The version is in each file name; to update, replace the file and the reference in `index.html`.

| File | Package | License |
|---|---|---|
| `hls-1.7.3.light.min.js` | `hls.js@1.7.3` (`dist/hls.light.min.js`) | Apache-2.0 |
| `tus-js-client-4.3.1.min.js` | `tus-js-client@4.3.1` (`dist/tus.min.js`) | MIT |
| `pdfjs-6.4.299.min.mjs`, `pdfjs-6.4.299.worker.min.mjs` | `pdfjs-dist@6.4.299` (`legacy/build/`) | Apache-2.0 |
